Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.19 fixes the chapter-21 cooperation buyer's dismiss narration: the closing line is now narrated and uses its own text instead of repeating the sold-goods narration under the customer's name. The vanilla per-deal "anything else?" line is unchanged. The 1.18 HD CGs/maid schedule, 1.17 cross-mod compatibility, 1.16 gala portrait fix, 1.15 two-person speaker/harem date fixes, 1.14 game-version policy and earlier fixes remain. Simplified Chinese / English. 1.19 修复第 21 章合作买家的离开旁白：改用旁白者并新增独立收尾句，不再把成交旁白重复一遍并署成客人的名字；原版每次成交后的“还要别的吗”保持原样。保留 1.18 高清 CG 与侍从线排期、1.17 跨 MOD 兼容、1.16 晚会立绘修复、1.15 双人演出名字与后宫约会日修复、1.14 游戏版本策略及更早修复。简体中文 / English。
